# REMAINING_WORK

## Wave 1 — Active
- [ ] Close non-first-level and nested commerce discovery gaps.
- [ ] Define alias semantics for duplicate physical routes without double-selling the same capability.
- [ ] Make marketplace merchandising use live server catalog testimony.
- [ ] Show both purchasable credits and supporter tiers on discovery cards.
- [ ] Mount marketplace merchandising through the global/shared boot path.
- [ ] Add product identity attributes to game cards without touching dirty app renderer when avoidable.
- [ ] Add canonical coverage/readiness tests.
- [ ] Verify headers, tabs, line counts, syntax, commerce tests, and readback.

## Wave 2
- [ ] Wire real app/game feature actions into generic product-credit consumption.
- [ ] Add paid-action client/coordinator with preserved context and receipt UX.
- [ ] Define success-before-charge or reserve/commit behavior for expensive asynchronous work.
- [ ] Upgrade shared commerce CSS and catalog cards for 360px mobile/a11y/reduced motion.
- [ ] Replace crawler-empty marketplace inventory with generated crawlable catalog content.
- [ ] Generate product-detail marketing metadata/pages from canonical product truth.

## Wave 3+
- [ ] Universal search/command palette, recents, favorites, workflow graph and cross-app handoffs.
- [ ] PWA/offline/performance budgets and visual-regression matrix.
- [ ] SEO/OpenGraph/sitemap/screenshots/release automation.
- [ ] Funnel analytics, economy metrics, observability, reconciliation and fraud controls.
- [ ] Game progression/cosmetics/achievements without pay-to-win.
- [ ] Team/enterprise billing and policy controls.
- [ ] Creator marketplace only after moderation, licensing, settlement and abuse controls exist.
